title: Rappler Recap: What are Zalameda, Dimaampao, and Marquez’s plans as chief justice bets?
summary: Rappler's justice beat reporter Jairo Bolledo shares in this recap

blocks.text: Rappler's justice beat reporter Jairo Bolledo shares in this recap

MANILA, Philippines – Associate Justices Rodil Zalameda, Japar Dimaampao, and Jose Midas Marquez faced the Judicial and Bar Council on Monday, October 26, as they bid to become the country’s next Supreme Court Chief Justice.
If they are chosen to succeed Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, what would they do as head of the judiciary?
Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo shares in this recap. – Rappler.com
